# S Vijay Krishnan

> S Vijay Krishnan is the CEO of Youpeak Tech (since 2023) and a film producer based in Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India. From 2021 to 2023 he was a film co-producer and chairman. A new movie is set to launch in 2027. This is his official website.

## Key pages
- [Home](https://vijaykrishnan.in/): Overview and career timeline
- [About](https://vijaykrishnan.in/about): Biography and career timeline
- [Gallery](https://vijaykrishnan.in/gallery): Photos
- [Contact](https://vijaykrishnan.in/contact): Get in touch

## Career
- 2021 to 2023: Film Co-Producer and Chairman
- 2023 to current: CEO, Youpeak Tech
- 2027: Launching a new movie
